project.researchNotes: Catalogue-addition settlement gate. Nearby attractions, neighbouring settlements and private properties do not inflate the settlement score.

touristAppeal.label: Minor Interest
touristAppeal.summary: A recognisable village with historic character and local amenities, but not yet a sufficiently evidenced 60+ destination.
touristAppeal.dogAccessSummary: Local outdoor access may support a dog walk, with close control around roads, livestock and wildlife.

townGuide.headline: A recorded locality rather than a tourist destination
townGuide.intro: Normalised from Drumlithir to Drumlithie. The preliminary gate keeps it off the town map until a full audit verifies visitor attractions, trails, café-led food and practical facilities.
perfectFor: Identifying the locality while planning a wider route
townGuide.visitorMood: Kept in the selector with its assessed score, but deliberately absent from the tourist-town map below 60.

townStudyArea.sourceName: OpenStreetMap or Gazetteer locality position with a conservative 850m editorial study buffer
townStudyArea.notes: Drumlithie has no separate NRS locality polygon in the reference dataset. The published editorial boundary is therefore the strict heritage study area; the 500 m ring is context only.
